quality.review_scope: Independent root R3 audit passed for all four supplied main pages of text, source pages 1–3 visually, three figures, Table 1, two proposed equations and the 15-reference bibliography. SI and cited references remain unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.
missing_fields: Complete supplied four-page main; no matching local SI located/read. Cited full sources, including chemical-analysis reference 14, are unreviewed.
Only the 1:2 recipe has explicit absolute MoO3 and sulfur charges. Other ratios inherit the stated same conditions, not an invented common precursor amount.
Sulfur is printed as 0.256 (8 mmol), without a mass unit; retain 8 mmol and the unitless original number without asserting 0.256 g.
The source prints sliver-lined stainless steel autoclave. Lining identity is not silently corrected; capacity is 30 mL, and 70% is total vessel fill, not pyridine volume.
Temperature ramp, autogenous pressure, stirring, collection technique, water doses, vacuum pressure and storage are unreported.
Figures 2 and 3, refined cell constants and the abstract yield do not explicitly identify a ratio-specific batch. These are separate study-wide contexts, not duplicated measurements for c and d.
No atomic coordinates, refined atomic model, interface geometry or functional lubrication/catalysis performance is supplied.
Independent source audit passed; presentation remains pending.
conflicts: IR prose assigns a band at 382 cm⁻¹, while the plotted label is 382.8. Preserve both without adding precision to the prose measurement.
Bibliography reference 13 prints Science 272, 1926 (1926); the printed year is retained without external correction.
